description: No authentication required. List every supported animation action_id grouped by camera view (side-scrolling, isometric, topDown), with preview image URLs you can show the user. Each action includes action_version and supports_upscale. Call this before generate_sprite to pick a valid action_id + view_type. For isometric, actions include per-direction previews.

view_type.description: Optional: return only actions for this camera view.

name: list_actions
title: List actions (no auth)
